summary: Hiroshi Tokushige is a Buddhist studies scholar who held posts at Koyasan University, attested as a contract researcher in 2015 and as a special appointed lecturer in 2026.
Hiroshi Yamashita is an Indology and religious studies scholar who studied at the University of Madras. He served as an associate professor at Tohoku University (attested 1996–1999).

Hirotaka Kato works in Buddhist studies and Sinology. He held a research assistant post at the Chion'in Jodo Sect Research Institute (attested 2015) and an associate professorship at Kyoto Bunkyo University (attested 2026).
Hiroyuki Kato was a scholar of philosophy and other fields. He held positions at Bansho Shirabesho (c. 1860–1862), the Kaisei School (c. 1863–1869), and the University of Tokyo (c. 1877–1893).
Hisanosuke Izui was a linguist who studied at Kyoto University from around 1926 to 1929. He later held a post at Kyoto Sangyo University from around 1969 to 1980.

Hisao Inagaki specialized in Buddhist studies, earning degrees from Kobe City University of Foreign Studies, Ryukoku University, and SOAS/University of London. He taught at SOAS (1969–1981) and served as professor at Ryukoku University (1981–1998).

Hisao Kanaseki was a scholar of Buddhist studies and other fields who studied at Doshisha University (c. 1938–1941). He held professorships at Kobe University (c. 1961–1968), Tokyo Metropolitan University (c. 1968–1982), and Komazawa University (c. 1982–1989).

Hisao Takahashi is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied at Taisho University under Ryukai Mano and held several posts there from circa 1976 until 2015, including professor from around 1996 to 2015.

Hisashi Matsumura is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He held posts at the Australian National University (attested 1982) and Kobe Shinwa University as an associate professor (attested 1996).

Hisashi Sato was a Tibetology and history/archaeology scholar who studied at Kyoto University (c. 1934–1937). He served as a professor at Kyoto University (c. 1965–1977), Bukkyo University (c. 1977–1984), Komazawa University, and Toyo University.

Hisataka Ishida works in Buddhist studies, Indology, and Tibetology, earning a Dr.phil. from the University of Vienna under Helmut Krasser in 2011. He was attested as a full-time lecturer at Aichi Gakuin University in 2015.

Hisatake Kato was a philosopher who studied at the University of Tokyo (c. 1957–1961). He held posts at Yamagata, Tokyo, Tohoku, Tottori University of Environmental Studies, and the University of Human Arts and Sciences between 1967 and 2009.

Hisayoshi Miyamoto is a scholar of Indology, religious studies, and philosophy who studied under Kamlesh Dutt Tripathi. He was attested in 2026 as a lecturer at both the International College for Postgraduate Buddhist Studies and the International Institute for Buddhist Studies.

Hitoshi Inui is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Kanjin Horiuchi. He held posts at the Institute of Esoteric Buddhist Culture (attested 1992) and at Koyasan University (attested 1986, and as professor in 2015).

Hitoshi Kato is a scholar of Buddhist studies, philosophy, and Japanology. He held positions at Osaka University of Foreign Studies, Nara University of Education, and Otani University (attested 1992), and served as professor at Osaka University (attested 2016–2017).

Hla Pe was a linguist who studied at the University of Rangoon and the University of London (SOAS). He joined SOAS to teach Burmese language and culture in 1948 and served as Professor of Burmese from 1966 to 1980.
Ho-chin Yang is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. Yang earned a PhD at the University of Washington in 1994 under the supervision of Leonard W. J. van der Kuijp.
Hoin Yamada is a scholar of Buddhist studies. Yamada studied at Ryukoku University from circa 1959 to 1963 and was a disciple of Gyoin Hashimoto from circa 1959 to 1981.
Hoju is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Peking University (c. 1999–2003) and KU Leuven (c. 2005–2007), and taught Kyokuga Saeki.
Hoju Shioda is a Buddhist studies scholar. In 2026, Shioda was attested in posts at Minobusan University and the Nakamura Hajime Eastern Institute.
